_doc: Elemental classes (Wave 1). A chimera's class is DERIVED from its parts, never assigned: each part may carry classAffinity ('air' | 'ground' | 'water'), granted by anatomy — wings and airfoils give air, gills/fins/flippers give water, feet/paws/hooves/legs give ground. The class with the most parts wins; a tie leaves the creature Unclassed (neutral both directions), so committing to one anatomy buys the matchup edge while hybrids trade it for safety. chart: attacker class vs defender class -> damage multiplier. Enemies declare their class directly in enemies.json.

flavor.ground_water: Solid footing beats a flopping swimmer on dry land.
flavor.water_air: A soaked flyer is a falling flyer.
flavor.air_ground: You cannot punch what refuses to stay on the ground.
flavor.unclassed: No dominant anatomy — nothing to exploit, nothing to be exploited.
